title: Dispatch a control relay
task: Collect the boxed relay from receiving and place it securely on the outbound sort shelf.
robot: robosuite PandaOmron with articulated Panda Hand
hazard: The carton tips off the shelf edge into the lower return tote.
method: Base velocity control on the planar Omron drive, bounded seven-joint inverse kinematics, torque feedback and friction grasp; the payload is a free rigid body throughout. No wheel slip or motor temperature model.

safe.outcome: The item settles on the outbound shelf.

steps.text: Leave the dispatch bay and align with the source bench.
Stop at the bench and lower the open fingers around the outbound relay carton.
Close the two finger pads and establish a friction grasp.
Lift clear of the source and retract to the transport posture.
Carry the item through the cross aisle.
Dwell at the outbound barcode portal before continuing.
Align the chassis with the receiving fixture and finish the approach.
Dock at the receiving station and extend the arm.
Center the carton on the outbound shelf.
Open the fingers and let the item settle.
Retract the empty arm to the transport posture.
Drive to the parking bay and stop.

safe.impulse_window: Through final payload settling; excludes subsequent static support.
